newsitem.title: USA: Ashland Exploration names Tiefel president.
newsitem.headline: Ashland Exploration names Tiefel president.

text.p: Ashland Exploration Inc, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Ashland Inc, on Wednesday named W. Paul Tiefel as president.
Tiefel succeeds G. Thomas Wilkinson, who served as president of the exploration company and as a senior vice president of the corporation.

The company said Wilkinson led the exploration company for more than six years through a period of unparalleled growth and income generation, but elected to retire as Ashland moves toward the recently announced initial public offering and spin-off of Ashland Exploration.
Tiefel joined Ashland Exploration as chief drilling engineer in 1982. Most recently, he served as senior vice president of Ashland Exploration, the company said.
Ashland Exploration is engaged in exploration and production of crude oil and natural gas in the United States and overseas.
